supersedes.reason: Pre-outcome source-parity review found that v1 omitted the frozen ECRS G7 news blackout and failed to freeze several exact boundary/indexing rules. No real-data identity count, market outcome, trade, or PnL was read before this amendment.

purpose: Freeze exact outcome-blind identity mirrors for ECRS and SCC/PBP before T2 sees trigger counts, excursions, trades, PnL, or any economic result.
prohibitions: No excursion, trade, PnL, win-rate, PF, expectancy, drawdown, target/stop result, or chart-outcome field may be read or emitted.
D7 and D8 cannot select, tune, rescue, promote, rank, or contribute trial credit to A0-A4.
No threshold or event key may change after any real-data identity count is exposed; a necessary pre-outcome change requires a new contract version.
ECRS v2 is secondary diagnostic only and cannot replace the exact ECRS v1 mirror required by P0/P2.
Formula-generalization on symbols other than EURUSD is never prior-identity overlap.

primary_scope.data_clock: FivePercent server-aligned M5 with UTC entry timestamps
primary_scope.comparison_rule: Compare T2 structural candidates only on the same primary scope and covered timestamp window.

exact_gates.G1: ER10[t-1] < 0.28 and ER10[t] >= 0.38; ER denominator is sum(abs(close[j]-close[j-1]), j=t-9..t), zero denominator invalid.
exact_gates.G2: ATR14[t-1] <= 0.70 * SMA20(ATR14)[t-1]; ATR14 is the bound indicators.py atr_mt5 simple rolling mean of canonical true range.
exact_gates.G3: Long close[t] > max(high[t-12..t-1]); short close[t] < min(low[t-12..t-1]).
exact_gates.G5: Long close[t] > EMA20[t] and EMA20[t] > EMA20[t-3]; short is the exact mirror; EMA is pandas-compatible adjust=False seeded from the first close.
exact_gates.G6: The immediate next M5 bar exists and its UTC time is 07:00 inclusive to 16:30 exclusive.
exact_gates.G7: No bound high-impact EURUSD news event lies within plus or minus 45 minutes inclusive of the immediate next-bar UTC entry time.
exact_gates.G8: Immediate next-bar spread is finite and 0 < spread/10 <= 0.8 pips under the frozen five-digit EURUSD source convention.

lawful_forward_fields: immediate next-bar open for audit only
d7_ecrs_exact_mirror.comparison_population: All T2 structural candidate identities A0-A3 before probability thresholding and daily consumption, restricted to the exact primary scope/window.
d7_ecrs_exact_mirror.jaccard: size(intersection) / size(union); empty/empty is INVALID, never zero or pass.
d7_ecrs_exact_mirror.fatal_gate: Close T2 before build when Jaccard > 0.50 and residual decisions cannot be attributed to immutable locked-barrier provenance plus causal event order/duration from P2.
secondary_diagnostics: Per-arm A0-A3 Jaccard against ECRS v1 exact.
ECRS v2 no-volume identity count and Jaccard, clearly labeled non-primary.
Formula-generalization on the other eight mandatory symbols, clearly labeled not prior-identity overlap and never used for the fatal gate.

d8_pbp_scc_mirror.primary_scope: Exact prior EURUSD M5 SCC source contract; other-symbol replay is formula-generalization only.

t2_pbp_like_population.eligibility: An otherwise structurally valid A3 candidate before the hard PBP exclusion fires.

subsets.PBP_BREAK_WINDOW: A same-direction immutable locked-barrier close-break occurred in k-7..t-1.
subsets.PBP_TOMBSTONE_CONTACT: A correction bar contacted the symbol-tick-normalized price of a still-valid 48-bar tombstone from a previously broken same-direction barrier.

t2_pbp_like_population.economic_authority: NONE; every event remains SKIP_PBP_EXCLUDED and absent from A4.

scc_control_identity.sequence: confirmed N=2 fractal pivot -> first completed close break; pivot consumed on the first break

scc_challenger_identity.sequence: SCC control break -> next retained M5 bar HOLD -> first-passage retest within 12 bars

d8_pbp_scc_mirror.price_match: Exact symbol-tick price equality after both references are normalized to the same symbol tick size.
comparison_outputs: T2 PBP_BREAK_WINDOW vs SCC_CONTROL_BREAK exact intersection and Jaccard
T2 PBP_TOMBSTONE_CONTACT vs SCC_CHALLENGER_RETEST exact intersection and Jaccard
Unmatched identities with causal reason codes only
d8_pbp_scc_mirror.decision_rule: D8 is diagnostic-only. Any material semantic reconstruction of SCC forces a pre-build T2 close or a fresh generation; D8 cannot authorize a PBP arm.

implementation_acceptance: Pure deterministic emitters and comparator; public APIs reject recursive outcome fields.
SHA verification of this contract and every bound source before execution.
Exact-key, empty-set invalidity, duplicate-key rejection, timezone, symbol-tick normalization and long-short mirror fixtures.
An independent parity fixture compares every D7 boolean gate and final identity against the bound ECRS source semantics.
Prefix invariance for both mirrors and T2 identity emitters.
Full identity ledgers are used; sampled casebooks are forbidden for Jaccard.
Execution remains blocked until the design-only price input is covered by the frozen T2 data epoch and all data-quality constraints.
